name: Enchanted Gaea Seeds
summary: At Sun Rock Retreat, Enchanted Gaea Seeds are prepared for the Charred Vale. Druidic magic gives them strength to take root in ash-choked soil and begin restoring Kalimdor's ravaged land.

sections.title: A Spark in the Ashes
sections.body: The Horde's druids are trying to heal the deep scars across Stonetalon Mountains. At Sun Rock Retreat, Tammra Windfield enchants raw Gaea Seeds so they can withstand corruption and elemental blight. Planted in the fertile dirt mounds beneath the Charred Vale's soot, they take root despite the harsh land. Hostile fire elementals and invasive harpies still dominate the vale.

sections.title: The Promise of Renewal
sections.body: Planting the seeds is part of the struggle for Stonetalon's future. Their enchanted husks resist lingering corruption and give native plants a foothold. The returning vegetation is meant to soothe agitated fire elementals, crowd out feral harpies, and counter the deforestation caused by the Venture Company's relentless logging.

faq.q: What are Enchanted Gaea Seeds used for?
aliases: what do enchanted gaea seeds do
faq.answer: Plant the seeds in fertile dirt mounds in the Charred Vale. They are meant to grow resilient plants that resist corruption and begin healing land scarred by fire and warfare.

faq.q: Who created or enchanted these seeds?
faq.answer: Raw Gaea Seeds are gathered in the surrounding wilderness and brought to Tammra Windfield at Sun Rock Retreat. She enchants them to help them survive the Charred Vale's hostile, ash-laden soil.

faq.q: Why must they be planted in the Charred Vale?
faq.answer: The Charred Vale is the center of ecological destruction in the Stonetalon Mountains, overrun by angry fire elementals and harpies. Planting the seeds in its surviving soil mounds brings new life meant to soothe the region's turmoil.

faq.q: What threats face the planted seeds?
faq.answer: Hostile fire elementals born of the blaze and aggressive Bloodfury harpies nesting in the ruins threaten the planted seeds. The Venture Company's nearby operations bring further industrial destruction.

angles.text: As a druid, you help nurture the cycle of rebirth, coaxing resilient life back into a land consumed by ruin and wildfire.
As one of the Shu'halo of Sun Rock Retreat, you plant the enchanted seeds as spiritual stewardship, honoring the Earth Mother and reclaiming wounded land.
